newsitem.title: USA: Tyco preferred holders balk at Mattel offer-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Tyco preferred holders balk at Mattel offer-WSJ.

text.p: Holders of Tyco Toys Inc Series Preferred C shares do not want their holdings to be converted in Mattel Inc shares and could try to keep Mattel's acquisition of Tyco from being completed under current terms, said the Wall Street Journal Thursday.
According to the newspaper, Tyco Series C holders would lose their 8.25 percent dividned paid on the shares.
"Nothing is in jeopardy here," a Mattel spokesman said in the article.
"In the end we're prepared to do whatever is necessary with the Series C holders to complete the merger," he said.
